summary: Brief second amendment stating that UnitedHealth issued an April 22, 2024 press release on its ongoing data assessment for the Change Healthcare cyberattack, support for impacted individuals, notification support for providers and customers, and service restoration progress; the press release is incorporated by reference.
new_vs_prior: New relative to the March 8 amendment: (1) the data assessment is now described as ongoing with 'impacted individuals' being supported, indicating individuals' data was affected; (2) the Company is helping providers and customers with notifications; (3) restoration is still in progress as of April 22, 2024. The filing drops the explicit materiality statement that appeared in the two earlier filings and gives no new attribution or disruption details in the Item 1.05 text itself.
